task.title: Skip CAS subtrees excluded by literal include prefixes
task.problem: Content filtering constructs logical paths after reading every Directory, even for a literal include prefix that selects one small subtree.
task.proposal: Descend only into the union of provably relevant prefixes; keep the existing file matcher and fall back to full traversal for any include that could match elsewhere.
acceptance: Differential tests compare order, records and exit status for overlapping includes, a basename-only include mixed with a prefix, exclusions, .git and no matches. Specify behavior for unreadable subtrees; do not hide incomplete-cache errors silently.
Compare Directory reads and elapsed search time for selective and broad queries on the same tree, confirming fewer reads for the selective case and no material broad-scan regression.
evidence: 100 directories × 80 files, one selected directory: 16.6 ms baseline vs 6.4 ms for a literal-prefix prototype. See https://github.com/rmorozov/bst-utilities/pull/17#pullrequestreview-6013606582 and docs/source-grep-performance.md.
